payload.objective: Extend Yield Harvester from nominal profit ranking to first-withdrawable-dollar continuity, household-relief prioritization, live mechanism scouting, and safe repository intake.
payload.scope: Continuity controller, payout/withdrawability gates, posted-reward source class, read-only live-source and repository scouting, and tests. No miner installation, trading, transaction signing, account creation, terms acceptance, capital deployment, wallet creation, or network exposure.
acceptance_criteria: One realized withdrawable dollar is a valid milestone.
Nominal balances below payout thresholds do not count as available money.
Operating continuity and household relief precede discretionary surplus.
Private household targets remain runtime inputs rather than committed configuration.
Unsafe stealth/miner loaders are rejected instead of installed.
Capital-requiring trading infrastructure is deferred while Vera Fund is zero.
